prompt: Many people in cities live alone or in small family units instead of with extended family. Do you think this is a positive or negative development? Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant
essay:
Nowadays, more and more individuals living in large cities are living alone or in small families instead of big families .In this essay, I will be discussing why I strongly believe that it is a positive development.

To begin with,  many individuals living in cities prefer having small families because everything in cities is becoming extremely expensive. To elaborate, cities in general are more developed than towns ,so in this case, if individuals lived in a small family , they would be able to take care of themselves and provide all the essential things they need.A study has shown that 80 per cent of homes in the UK have a maximum  of 4 people living in one house.

Another reason to support my argument is that small families have good communication with each other since they are not big , and everyone can get along well. To illustrate, when people are getting along with their parents and siblings, this will reduce the amount of any possible misunderstanding and any toxic thinking between them. As a result, an understanding family and a supportive environment are being provided by them.

In my opinion, I believe that having a family is one of the most crucial things in a human life because they offer support and love to each other , and they are always there when we need them

In conclusion, more people like living alone or in small families due to the comfort that it gives them in different life situations.
